<thought>Based on the molecular ion (m/z ≈ 262) and the 13C NMR data (one carbonyl at ~166 ppm, a methoxy carbon at ~52 ppm, and many aromatic carbons), the compound is best described as a methyl ester of a di‑hydroxy‑phenyl‑benzoic acid, i.e., a methyl 3,4‑dihydroxy‑phenyl benzoate. Its SMILES representation is:

COC(=O)c1c(O)ccc(O)c1c2ccccc2

This string matches the observed formula (C₁₄H₁₄O₅) and the spectroscopic features.</thought>
<final_answer>COC(=O)c1c(O)ccc(O)c1c2ccccc2</final_answer>
